watches.name: Metric - Chrono Taxi
watches.description: Designed around an icon. Taxi yellow meets matte black on a dial that’s unmistakably New York. A checkered stripe runs straight through the center, the same pattern you know from the side of a cab. Start the chronograph and that checkered seconds hand sweeps across the dial. At six o’clock, “New York” sits quietly, a nod to the city that inspired every detail. Limited to just 1000 pieces.

specsRaw.MOVEMENT: HYBRID VK68 MECA-QUARTZ CHRONOGRAPH Read more Read less
specsRaw.Turn it over and the theme continues: a high-polish checkered caseback with the Brew coffee bean at its center. That’s a reminder of where Brew began, timing the perfect espresso shot, and where we’re headed.

watches.name: Metric Lite - Retro (30mm)
watches.description: METRIC LITE: A new take on a Brew classic. Inspired by our original Metric Retro Dial, the Metric Lite reimagines its signature design in our most compact case yet at just 30mm - now powered by an automatic movement. Smaller in scale, mechanical at heart, and designed with the same retro character that defined the original. A refined new expression of the Metric, made for those who appreciate a more understated silhouette. Brew 1:1 Size Guide Watch Comparison Guide

watches.name: Metric - Bloom Chronograph Watch
watches.description: METRIC BLOOM CHRONOGRAPH: Inspired by the flowing movement of espresso being poured into a cup, the Metric Bloom captures the warmth, motion, and texture of coffee in motion. Its three-dimensional copper and warm crema-toned dial features vertically flowing ripple patterns that rise from six o’clock toward twelve, echoing the natural movement of espresso as it blooms and settles.
